segments.text: Three kinds of people Allah Himself says He loves. Most of us forget the third.
Number one. The ones who keep coming back. No matter how many times they slip, they turn around and return to Him.
Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant, and those who purify themselves.
segments.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلتَّوَّٰبِينَ وَيُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ

segments.text: Number two. The ones who hold on through the pain. When life is breaking them, and they still do not let go of Allah.
Number three, the one we forget. The ones who quietly do good. Who help, who give, expecting nothing back.
Indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.
So if you have been repenting, or holding on, or quietly doing good, then know this. You are loved by the One whose love never runs out.
